old_caption: The video opens with a wide shot of a vast desert landscape under a clear blue sky. In the distance, a range of mountains stretches across the horizon, adding depth to the scene. The foreground features a flat, sandy terrain with scattered rocks and debris. A large, weathered semi-truck is positioned centrally in the frame. An explosion erupts from the truck, engulfing it in a sudden, bright fireball. A massive plume of smoke and debris is sent into the air, obscuring parts of the truck and the landscape. The surrounding environment is filled with dust and debris, which scatter across the ground and into the air. The explosion is violent and rapid, with debris and smoke rising quickly, obscuring the truck and the landscape.
original_wisa_caption: The video opens with a wide shot of a vast desert landscape under a clear blue sky. In the distance, a range of mountains stretches across the horizon, adding depth to the scene. The foreground features a flat, sandy terrain with scattered rocks and debris. A large, rusted semi-truck is positioned centrally in the frame, its body showing significant wear and tear. As the video progresses, an explosion occurs at the rear of the truck, sending a massive plume of smoke and debris into the air. The explosion is intense, with flames and smoke billowing upwards and outward, creating a dramatic visual effect. The surrounding environment is filled with dust and debris, which scatter across the ground and into the air, obscuring parts of the truck and the landscape. The explosion continues for several seconds, with the smoke and debris gradually dissipating, revealing more of the desert and the mountains in the background. The video captures the raw power and chaos of the explosion, contrasting sharply with the serene and expansive
caption: On a flat, pale desert plain beneath a clear blue sky, a low mountain range stretches across the horizon and a small white cloud floats at the left. A white semi-truck tractor unit sits parked near the center, its cab, exposed chassis, and wheels intact with no trailer attached. A large gray-brown dust cloud hangs over the right-middle background, drifting slowly while the truck remains still. A bright orange-white fireball erupts at the truck's location, obscuring the cab and expanding upward and outward into a rounded blast cloud as dark fragments scatter radially into the sky. The luminous fire fades into a turbulent tan-and-white dust cloud that keeps growing, while larger debris—cab panels, wheels, and dark chunks—tumble and fly outward and upward. A light-colored panel arcs high through the air, and wheels roll across the ground at the right as parts translate away from the blast center and fall. The dust cloud thickens and spreads across the original truck position, becoming the dominant feature, while the background cloud persists and merges with the new blast cloud. The camera framing and background positions remain constant, fixing the explosion's center at the truck's original ground location.
